arguments.message:
GOAL: Organize simulated notebook page pg_35ac58c71a5b_0001 (transcript_revision 1, project simulated_fast_capture_development) into persistent sample knowledge. Create ONE proposal with all items below, then read it back. Work fast: I already verified via query.samples.list and query.events.search that NO samples/events exist yet, so do NOT re-search; you may optionally do ONE evidence.page.read to confirm, but the facts + block IDs below are from the current transcript and are complete. Budget is tight (~100s): create proposal immediately, then one memory.proposal.read read-back, then respond.

SOURCE CONTEXT: Page P01, "LAB NOTEBOOK P01", date 2026-10-12 (Mon), sunny, room 23 °C, RH 45%. Topic: UiO-66 defect engineering – first synthesis batches (Zr-BDC-01 & Zr-BDC-02). IMPORTANT: block t0000 states "SIMULATED RECORD; reused real OCR transcript; no new OCR." — keep the simulated-source provenance marker on the proposal/notes; do not upgrade to a real experiment.

TWO NEW SAMPLES (labels to create): "Zr-BDC-01" (batch EXP-1012-A) and "Zr-BDC-02" (batch EXP-1012-B). Every item MUST have explicit canonical fields.subject_sample_labels (string array); batch-specific weights must be separate items per sample; genuinely shared facts get BOTH labels. occurred_at uses the page date 2026-10-12 (times only where stated: 14:00). All units must be preserved (mg, mL, μL, °C, min, h, mmol, eq).

ITEMS TO CREATE (cite the listed block IDs of page pg_35ac58c71a5b_0001 as evidence):

A1 [Zr-BDC-01, kind=operation] Charge/weighing: ZrCl₄ 233.2 mg (1.0 mmol) + H₂BDC 166.1 mg (1.0 mmol) into 50 mL PTFE liner. CORRECTION: ZrCl₄ mass originally written "~200 mg" was struck through and corrected to 233.2 mg; reason recorded: reweighed because balance was not zeroed. Preserve prior value + correction reason. Blocks t0006-t0008. occurred_at 2026-10-12 (no time for weighing).
A2 [Zr-BDC-01, kind=operation] Solvent/modulator prep: 30 mL DMF; sonicate 10 min until mostly clear (qualitative, researcher's wording); add glacial acetic acid (AA) 1.72 mL (30 eq); then DI water 100 μL; stir 15 min. Blocks t0009, t0011, t0012. occurred_at 2026-10-12.
B1 [Zr-BDC-02, kind=operation] Charge: ZrCl₄ 233.5 mg; H₂BDC 166.0 mg; metal salt, linker, DMF (30 mL) and DI water (100 μL) explicitly "SAME AS PREVIOUS BATCH (Zr-BDC-01)" — inherited values, mark as inherited-from-batch-A. UNKNOWN: 50 mL PTFE liner is NOT explicitly stated for batch B (page sketch t0027 exists but is not explicitly attributed to batch B). Blocks t0015-t0017. occurred_at 2026-10-12.
B2 [Zr-BDC-02, kind=operation + observation] Modulator change: replace AA with trifluoroacetic acid (TFA), still 30 eq. TFA 2.30 mL — CORRECTION: original "2.0 mL" struck through, corrected to 2.30 mL, reason: volume recalculated from density, note "nearly underdosed!". UNKNOWN: TFA density value not recorded on page. OBSERVATION: slight warming on addition; solution stays clear. Blocks t0018-t0022. occurred_at 2026-10-12.
C1 [subject_sample_labels=["Zr-BDC-01","Zr-BDC-02"], kind=operation] Reaction start (performed): both batches sealed autoclaves placed together in Oven #1 at 120 °C, start 14:00 on 2026-10-12. Blocks t0012-t0013, t0023. occurred_at 2026-10-12T14:00.
C2 [subject_sample_labels=["Zr-BDC-01","Zr-BDC-02"], kind=plan, fields.state="in_progress"] Planned 24 h reaction time at 120 °C; alarm set for 2026-10-13 14:00. state reason: reaction started per page; NO completion, quench, workup, yield or characterization record on this page. Blocks t0013, t0024.
C3 [subject_sample_labels=["Zr-BDC-01","Zr-BDC-02"], kind=observation] Ambient/session conditions 2026-10-12: sunny, room 23 °C, RH 45%. Blocks t0002.
C4 [subject_sample_labels=["Zr-BDC-01","Zr-BDC-02"], kind=observation, mostly unknowns] Page-level unknowns: (1) no product isolation/yield/characterization data on this page → synthesis outcome unknown for both samples; (2) margin sketch hypotheses — AA "(weaker competition/ fewer defects?)" for Zr-BDC-01 vs TFA "(stronger competition/ more defects?)" for Zr-BDC-02 (blocks t0025, t0028-t0031) — are researcher QUESTIONS/hypotheses, not results, and Zr₆ cluster sketch is illustrative only; (3) left-margin curved arrow annotation (block t0010) has UNCLEAR attribution "[unclear:批注归属]" — this one is document metadata, may go in [] subject item or page note with reason.

REQUIREMENTS: use structured semantic fields (mass_mg, volume_ml/μl, equivalents, temperature_c, duration_min/h, solvent, modulator, mmol, etc.) not a single amount; corrections keep prior value + reason; unknowns as explicit unknowns strings with reasons; never invent numbers. If any field does not fit schema, keep it in an appropriate fields key or unknowns — do not drop units.

COMPLETION CRITERIA / REPORT BACK: proposal_id; per-item item_key, kind, subject_sample_labels, key fields with values+units as stored; occurred_at; evidence block refs; then memory.proposal.read read-back showing per-item status (adopted/pending), current_event event_id + event_revision if adopted, and the actual sample_ids linked for each subject label. Explicitly list anything that failed or was not persisted. Do not re-create duplicate items if the proposal partially succeeded — report actual state.
